pairs=[]
for txt in user_texts:
    starts=list(re.finditer(r'Demo pair (\d+) input \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',txt))
    for m in starts:
        n,h,w=map(int,m.groups())
        outm=re.search(rf'Demo pair {n} output \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',txt[m.end():])
        if not outm: continue
        in_end=m.end(); out_start=in_end+outm.start(); out_end=in_end+outm.end()
        ig=[list(map(int,l.split())) for l in txt[in_end:out_start].strip().splitlines() if l.strip()]
        oh,ow=map(int,outm.groups())
        tail=txt[out_end:]
        oglines=[]
        for l in tail.splitlines():
            if not l.strip(): break
            if not re.fullmatch(r'[0-9 ]+',l.strip()): break
            oglines.append(list(map(int,l.split())))
        og=oglines
        pairs.append((n,ig,og,(h,w),(oh,ow)))
print([(n,len(a),len(a[0]),len(b),len(b[0])) for n,a,b,_,_ in pairs])
